formNote: Message received through the website form:
private: Your address book is private: only the site team can see it.
emptyBook: Your address book is empty. Add a first person: a name is enough.
emptySearch: No card matches. Try another word, or remove a filter.
reviewBanner: This card comes from the website contact form. Check it, then say it is checked.
confirmAccountRemove: Remove this account from the card?
noAccounts: No account yet. Add one below.
helpHandle: Paste the profile address, or type the handle.
accountExisted: This account is already on the card.
errEmptyHandle: Paste a link or type a handle.
errWrongNetwork: This is a {network} link: choose « {network} » in the Network list.
errHandle_twitch: This is not a Twitch channel. Paste the channel address (for example twitch.tv/name) or type the handle (4 to 25 letters, digits or _).
errHandle_youtube: This is not a YouTube channel. Paste the channel address (for example youtube.com/@name), not a video's.
errHandle_tiktok: This is not a TikTok account. Paste the profile address (for example tiktok.com/@name) or type @name.
errHandle_instagram: This is not an Instagram account. Paste the profile address (for example instagram.com/name) or type the name.
errHandle_discord: Type the Discord username (for example player.name) or paste a discord.gg/… invite.
errHandle_x: This is not an X account. Paste the profile address (for example x.com/name) or type @name (15 characters at most).
errHandle_bluesky: This is not a Bluesky account. Type the name (for example name.bsky.social) or paste the bsky.app/profile/… address.
errHandle_mastodon: Write the full Mastodon account, with its server: @name@server.social, or paste the profile address.
errHandle_web: Paste a complete website address, for example https://www.mysite.com.
errTaken: This account is already on the card « {name} ». Open it to remove the account, or merge both cards.
errTooManyAccounts: This card already has 20 accounts: remove one first.
suggestTwitch: shows the photo and follower count of your contacts' Twitch accounts
suggestYoutube: shows the photo and subscriber count of your contacts' YouTube channels
othersHelp: This text was written before structured accounts. It stays as it is; the accounts found in it can be added in one click.
photoHelp: Without a chosen image, the photo comes from the account with the most followers.
photoInvalid: This image cannot be used: upload an image from your device, or paste an https address.
name: Name
helpOrganisation: Type its name: the organisation's card is created if it does not exist yet.
helpRelation: How you know each other, in a few words.
helpNewCategory: It is created and added to this card in one go.
emailInvalid: This e-mail address is incomplete: write it like name@example.com.
emailTaken: This address is already on another card.
bookFull: The address book is full (100,000 cards). Delete useless cards before adding new ones.
movedTo: This card was merged into another one.
openMoved: Open the card that was kept
busy: The address book is getting ready. Try again in a few seconds.
hiddenContact: E-mails and phone numbers only show with the « see e-mails and phone numbers » right.
noMembers: Nobody is linked to this organisation yet.
deleteHelp: This is final: the card and its notes disappear. The other modules that mention it are told.
confirmDeleteContact: Delete this card and its notes? This is final.
deletedSilent: Card deleted. Did not answer in time: {modules} (their reference may remain).
categoriesHelp: A category groups cards (for example « Raid target »). A card can have several.
confirmCatDelete: Delete this category? The cards are not deleted.
catInvalid: Write a name of 1 to 100 characters.
catTooMany: The address book already has 500 categories.
catMergeHelp: « {name} » disappears: its cards join the chosen category. The cards are not deleted.
catMerged: Done: the cards joined the other category.
catDeleted: Category deleted. The cards are not deleted.
catDenied: Your role does not allow creating categories.
